system.description: The target swims as if water were its natural environment, even without the Swimming specialty, and makes no rolls in calm water. Agility rolls required for swimming gain +2 SV per power level. Beyond a depth equal to three times the target’s height, each additional metre imposes −2 SV.
system.summary: Allows easy swimming and improves swimming rolls.
